method: one 997 Hz sine (an exact bin) at -20, -12 and -6 dBFS peak, the drive control at 11 norms; per position the fundamental's gain (out - in) and the 2nd-5th harmonics by exact Goertzel bins (probe --response tones=1 harmonics=5): thd_db = 10 log10 (sum of harmonic power / fundamental power), thd_pct its square root x 100, even_odd_db = (h2 + h4) / (h3 + h5) in dB; onset = the first position by norm whose THD reaches 1 % / 0.1 %; inert = fundamental within 0.05 dB and no harmonic above -90 dB everywhere
